# Bundled infrared code attribution

The bundled `.ir` profiles are selected from Flipper-IRDB at commit
`d126fb1b6f1e114c52b4a8c19839ea65e3a9c24d`.

Source: https://github.com/Lucaslhm/Flipper-IRDB

License for these selected files: CC0 1.0
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Flipper-IRDB states that commits before
`2319685f2cbf0cd3f809609622cade14d24fb819` are not covered by that license.
IR Hunter therefore bundles only files added after that boundary. The complete
upstream archive is deliberately not included because its older files do not
carry the current CC0 grant.
